bio: The Dilly (formerly Le Meridien Piccadilly Hotel) opened as a hotel in 1908, designed by Richard Norman Shaw, in a Neo-Baroque style based on 17th century English Palladian architecture.  Inspired by Olympic Games, enjoy the ultimate indulgence pairing savoury sandwiches with tasty treats and teas. This Parisian themed Afternoon Tea brings you the best of London’s essence through local cuisine. Served at their restaurant, Terrace at The Dilly, experience this quaint British tradition with views across Piccadilly. Whether it's your first time to London or you're a local, this Afternoon Tea will delight adults and children alike.  A vegetarian menu is available. A non-themed vegan afternoon tea is available upon request when booked in advance.
